article_manifest.title: Sahel: violent fighting between the jihadists of Jnim and those of the ISE at the Mali-Burkina border
article_manifest.original_title: Sahel: violents combats entre les jihadistes du Jnim et ceux de l'EIS à la frontière Mali-Burkina
article_manifest.summary: Sahel: violent fighting between the jihadists of Jnim and those of ISIS at the Mali-Burkina border Major fighting has been taking place since August between the jihadists of Jnim, linked to al-Qaeda, and their rivals the Islamic State in the Sahel (ISIS). These fights are taking place on the border between Mali and Burkina Faso, also not far from the Nigerian border .

article_manifest.title: Nioro: a gesture of solidarity with the poorest
article_manifest.original_title: Nioro : un geste de solidarité envers les plus démunis
article_manifest.summary: In Nioro, elderly people, single women with family responsibilities, people living with disabilities and widows from the El Hadj Omar Tall military camp benefited from donations on Wednesday, October 14. Kits include millet, rice, oil, sugar, pasta and soap . The ceremony, organized as part of the Month of Solidarity and the Fight against Social Exclusion, ended with the presentation of certificates to the sponsors of the thematic weeks and the Month of Solidarity.

article_manifest.title: Two military operations targeting two armed positions in central Mali
article_manifest.original_title: عمليتان عسكريتان تستهدفان موقعين لمسلحين في وسط مالي
article_manifest.summary: On Thursday, the Malian army announced the targeting of two sites it said were sheltering armed men, one near the city of Diora and the other in the Ségou area, during two military operations on Wednesday and Thursday, without providing a toll of the losses. The army said in a statement that the first operation targeted a base 12 kilometers northwest of Diora, after being monitored based on intelligence information, noting that it included armed elements and military and logistical equipment.

article_manifest.title: Sectors of Dioura and Tongolo Coura: New terrorist bases targeted and destroyed by FAMa
article_manifest.original_title: Secteurs de Dioura et Tongolo Coura : De nouvelles bases terroristes ciblées et détruites par les FAMa
article_manifest.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national opinion that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing the permanent operations of surveillance, control and security of the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko . On Wednesday, October 14, 2026, the exploitation of precise intelligence made it possible to locate, 12 kilometers northwest of the city of Dioura, a large base housing several terrorist elements as well as war and logistics equipment.

article_manifest.title: 04:10 Counter-terrorism: The FAMa neutralize two important terrorist bases in the regions of Dioura and Ségou
article_manifest.original_title: 04:10 Lutte contre le terrorisme : Les FAMa neutralisent deux importantes bases terroristes dans les régions de Dioura et Ségou
article_manifest.summary: A major logistics base northwest of Dioura and a terrorist assembly point near Tongolo Coura have been destroyed, the General Staff of the Armed Forces announced in a statement, while noting that surveillance and research operations continue on the ground . On Wednesday, October 14, 2026, the exploitation of precise intelligence made it possible to locate, 12 kilometers northwest of the city of Dioura, a large base housing several terrorist elements as well as war and logistics equipment.

article_manifest.title: Ransom, zakat, territory: the war between Jnim and the Islamic State is intensifying in the Sahel
article_manifest.original_title: Rançons, zakat, territoire : la guerre entre le Jnim et l’État islamique s’intensifie au Sahel
article_manifest.summary: Ransom, zakat, territory: the war between Jnim and the Islamic State intensifies in the Sahel On October 10, bloody fighting pitted Jnim against the Islamic State in Burkina Faso.

article_manifest.title: Why China won’t build its own Wagner in Africa
article_manifest.original_title: Why China won’t build its own Wagner in Africa
article_manifest.summary: Attacks on Chinese workers in Mali are testing Beijing’s reliance on African security forces. Russia’s experience there gives China little reason to take on the fighting itself. On 9 May, fighters from Jama’at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM), al-Qaeda’s affiliate in the Sahel, stopped buses and trucks at Zambougou, in the Ségou region of Mali about 60 kilometres from Bamako, ordered the passengers out and burned at least 40 civilian vehicles.

article_manifest.title: Mali: The Army announces a tragic incident in an Fama area of operations
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : L’Armée annonce un incident tragique dans une zone d’opérations des FAMA
article_manifest.summary: In a statement issued yesterday, Wednesday, October 14, 2026, the General Staff of the Armed Forces of Mali said that it had been informed of a "tragic incident that occurred in an area of operations". "Loss of life as well as injuries" are to be deplored According to the first administrative information available, the victims "travelled on heavy-duty motorcycles between two localities".

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: The FAMa hit two terrorist positions in Dioura and Ségou
article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko : Les FAMa frappent deux positions des terroristes à Dioura et à Ségou
article_manifest.summary: Bamako, October 15, 2026 (AMAP) - The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, successfully carried out two strikes against positions housing terrorist elements, respectively 12 kilometers northwest of Dioura and near Tongolo-Coura, in the Ségou region, the General Staff of the Armed Forces said in a statement released Thursday. According to the press release, the exploitation of precise intelligence made it possible, on Wednesday, October 14, 2026, to locate a large base housing several terrorist elements as well as war and logistics equipment, 12 kilometers northwest of the city of Dioura.

article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso: Government pays tribute to Thomas Sankara, 39 years after his assassination
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina Faso : le gouvernement rend hommage à Thomas Sankara, 39 ans après son assassinat
article_manifest.summary: Burkina Faso: the government pays tribute to Thomas Sankara, 39 years after his assassination Burkina Faso pays tribute, this Thursday, October 15, 2026, to Captain Thomas Isidore Noël Sankara and his 12 companions, murdered on October 15, 1987. The ceremony is held in Ouagadougou, in the presence of members of the government and administrative and customary authorities .

article_manifest.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: the FAMa strike two terrorist positions
article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko : les FAMa frappent deux positions terroristes
article_manifest.summary: The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, carried out two strikes against suspected terrorist positions on 14 and 15 October 2026, as part of Operation Dougoukoloko, according to the General Staff of the Armed Forces . On Wednesday, October 14, a base housing combatants and war materiel was located 12 kilometers northwest of Dioura, thanks to intelligence.

article_manifest.title: Dr. Ahmadou Touré: "No sustainable development is possible without effective sovereignty"
article_manifest.original_title: Dr Ahmadou Touré : « Aucun développement durable n’est possible sans souveraineté effective »
article_manifest.summary: In his new book, "Sovereignty and State Refoundation in Mali (2020-2026): Towards the Alliance of Sahel States", professor-researcher Dr Ahmadou Touré analyses the trajectory opened in 2020. Assistant Professor and Director of the Sahel Governance, Mediation and Security Research Centre, he specifies the criteria for effective sovereignty and the conditions necessary for the consolidation of the ESA .

article_manifest.title: Kidal: After the army, reinstall the state
article_manifest.original_title: Kidal : Après l’armée, réinstaller l’État
article_manifest.summary: The FAMa took over Kidal on 6 October, almost six months after their withdrawal. Securing the city opens another project: restoring administration, bringing back public services and reconnecting with dispersed populations, while armed groups remain active. The Malian army has consolidated its presence after air and ground operations carried out as part of Operation Dougoukoloko .

article_manifest.title: Cybersecurity: Côte d 'Ivoire prepares its first national cyber crisis simulation
article_manifest.original_title: Cybersécurité : La Côte d’Ivoire prépare sa première simulation nationale de crise cyber
article_manifest.summary: Côte d 'Ivoire is preparing to organize its first national cyber crisis simulation. Called CYBER.EX 2026, this initiative will be held from 28 to 29 October 2026 at the Radisson Blu in Abidjan. Supported by the National Agency for the Security of Information Systems of Côte d 'Ivoire (ANSSI-CI), the event will bring together more than 800 participants around exercises intended to strengthen the response to cyber attacks .

article_manifest.title: Black October in Mali: when fear replaces solidarity
article_manifest.original_title: Octobre noir au Mali : quand la peur remplace la solidarité
article_manifest.summary: October is traditionally a month dedicated to solidarity and the fight against exclusion. It is also the month of Pink October, dedicated to raising awareness about breast cancer. A month that should rhyme with self-help, compassion and the protection of.

article_manifest.title: Diffa: Launch of a yellow fever vaccination campaign for nearly one million people
article_manifest.original_title: Diffa : Lancement d’une campagne de vaccination contre la fièvre jaune pour près d’un million de personnes
article_manifest.summary: Diffa, Oct 15 (ANP) – The Secretary General of the Diffa region, Mr. Mahamadou Attahirou Maidouka, on Thursday, October 15, 2026, at the Diffa Urban Integrated Health Center, officially launched the preventive vaccination campaign against yellow fever, scheduled for October 15 to 21 in the six departments of the region . This operation aims to vaccinate more than 95% of the target population, estimated at 999,877 people aged 9 months to 60 years.

article_manifest.summary: A memorial to the assassinated revolutionary, conceived by his followers, is being remade by the Sahel state’s military leader, Ibrahim Traoré, who casts himself as Sankara’s heir.

article_manifest.title: AGADEZ: Regional Security Council meeting extended to members of the National Commission for the Collection and Control of Illicit Weapons
article_manifest.original_title: AGADEZ : Réunion du Conseil Régional de Sécurité élargie aux membres de la Commission Nationale pour la Collecte et le Contrôle des Armes illicites
article_manifest.summary: Agadez, Oct 15 (ANP) – The Governor of the Region of Agadez, Major General Ibra Boulama Issa chaired, this Thursday, October 15, 2026 in the meeting room of the Governorate, a meeting of the Regional Security Council (CRS) extended to members of the National Commission for the Collection and Control of Illicit Weapons (CNCCAI) . The CNCCAI plays a strategic role in the Regional Security Council, bringing together the defense forces to coordinate efforts to collect and control illicit weapons, which contributes to peace and security in the region.

article_manifest.title: Between Us: No one is safe
article_manifest.original_title: Entre Nous: Nul n’est à l’abri
article_manifest.summary: The National Human Rights Commission recalls that no one is immune from the violation of their rights. In Mali, outrage is often selective. Sponsors and implementers of extrajudicial abductions and kidnappings should know that they can become victims .

article_manifest.title: Dialogue forum: Civil society and security services meet around the same table
article_manifest.original_title: Forum de dialogue : Société civile et services de sécurité se retrouvent autour d'une même table
article_manifest.summary: Representatives of civil society and security actors met this Wednesday, October 14 in Bamako, for the Community Dialogue Forum on Security Sector Governance . The opening ceremony was chaired by the representative of the Commissioner for Security Sector Reform (C-RSS), in the presence of Philipp Schweers, Acting Head of Mission of EUCAP Sahel Mali, the representative of the Governor of the District of Bamako, as well as representatives of pea and WANEP-Mali .

article_manifest.title: 7-October: Benyamin Netanyahu attacked in defamation by the former head of the Shin Beth
article_manifest.original_title: 7-Octobre: Benyamin Netanyahu attaqué en diffamation par l'ancien chef du Shin Beth
article_manifest.summary: For weeks, revelations have been going on in Israel to say that Benyamin Netanyahu did not follow up on alerts and warnings from foreign countries but also from his own security services concerning 7-October. Two weeks before the elections, the former head of the Shin Beth attacked the Prime Minister for defamation . He accuses her of lying about their respective responsibilities.

article_manifest.title: NSCDC arrest 2 over abortions, trafficking
article_manifest.original_title: NSCDC arrest 2 over abortions, trafficking
article_manifest.summary: The Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps (NSCDC) has arrested a 22-year-old man for allegedly trafficking a 17-year-old girl from Kwara State to Mali after promising to secure her employment in Senegal. The command also arrested a 56-year-old man accused of operating an unauthorised medical facility and performing abortions without recognised medical qualifications or a valid licence.

article_manifest.title: Africa: In Mali, From the Wagner Group to Africa Corps - Will Impunity Continue?
article_manifest.original_title: Africa: In Mali, From the Wagner Group to Africa Corps - Will Impunity Continue?
article_manifest.summary: When Africa Corps officially began operations in Mali in June 2025, few people held out hope that it would help alleviate the suffering of civilians in Mali, caused on the one hand by armed groups in Azawad and members from the Group for the Support of Islam and Muslims (GSIM), but also by the army and its auxiliaries from the Russian private military company known as Wagner.

article_manifest.title: National Youth Service: 2,400 recruits of the 7th cohort ready to serve The ceremony of their presentation to the flag was chaired, yesterday, on the place d 'armes of the Military Engineer, by the President of the Transition, Army General Assimi Goïta . For six months, these men and women followed a demanding program of military and civic training that allowed them to learn how to transform fatigue into endurance, difficulties into courage and constraints into responsibilities
article_manifest.original_title: Service national des jeunes : 2.400 recrues de la 7è cohorte prêtes à servir La cérémonie de leur présentation au drapeau a été présidée, hier, sur la place d’armes du Génie militaire, par le Président de la Transition, le Général d’armée Assimi Goïta. Pendant six mois, ces hommes et ces femmes ont suivi un programme exigeant de formation militaire et civique qui leur a permis d’apprendre à transformer la fatigue en endurance, les difficultés en courage et les contraintes en responsabilités
article_manifest.summary: This cohort includes 573 non-public servants and 1,827 civil servants. The 7th cohort of the National Youth Service (SNJ), composed of 2,400 recruits from the first and second waves, completed six months of military and civic training at the Bapho Training Center . The ceremony of presentation to the flag, presided over by the president of the Transition, Army General Assimi Goïta, took place yesterday at the Place d 'Armes of the Military Engineer, in an atmosphere of emotion and patriotic pride .
